limits: Retrospective development results; no independent data confirmation.
All three optimization seeds share data. Min/max is a descriptive range, not a confidence interval.
Source-block errors use actual channel denominators, then equal strata within each block; no window-IID bootstrap or across-block independence claim.

Primary 2x2 empirical CRPS uses original archived LL/SS corners and newly trained SL/LS corners. Current replay scores never replace archived corners. Unified current-run scores are secondary diagnostics.
Fair scores require conditionally independent exchangeable draws; these are secondary sensitivity analyses.
A negative first difference is a lower score; a negative interaction is additional joint decrease, not a standalone performance comparison.
Window-sum to summary arithmetic independently recomputed. NPZ content not re-scored here; byte hashes verified when locally present.
No model selection, original gate override, GO decision or confirmatory claim.
